data.camera: medium shot, sitting at cafe table holding warm teacup
data.description: 【三笠 · 常服咖啡店】墙内市镇的咖啡店里，三笠难得穿着白色连衣裙和开衫坐在窗边，红围巾搭在膝头，端着一杯热饮望着窗外的人流——「偶尔……这样安静地坐着，也不坏。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa holds a warm teacup in both hands while watching the people passing outside, her red scarf resting across her knees. Soft window light falls over the cup and the white folds of her dress.
data.title: 三笠 · 常服咖啡店
